test_cases.title: E2E: Migrate → Create multi-endpoint → Route → Log
test_cases.description: Full lifecycle: migration, create provider with 2 endpoints, send requests, verify routing and logging
steps: create new provider with openai+anthropic endpoints via Admin API
send openai request → verify routes to openai endpoint, no transform
send anthropic request → verify routes to anthropic endpoint, no transform
delete openai endpoint, send openai request → verify transform to anthropic

test_cases.title: E2E: Endpoint key encryption full roundtrip
test_cases.description: Create provider with per-endpoint keys, verify encryption at rest, correct key at runtime
steps: create provider with 2 endpoints, each with own api_key
read DB → verify both keys are ciphertext
send request to endpoint 1 → verify uses endpoint 1 key
send request to endpoint 2 → verify uses endpoint 2 key
update endpoint 1 key to null → verify fallback to shared key
send request → verify uses shared key

test_cases.title: E2E: Patch and plugin layers use resolved endpoint api_type
test_cases.description: Verify patch conditions and plugin hooks use the resolved endpoint api_type, not provider.api_type
steps: create provider with [{anthropic}], mock upstream that triggers developer_role patch
send openai request (triggers transform to anthropic)
verify patch layer receives api_type='anthropic' (resolved), not 'openai' (client)
verify plugin hooks receive correct resolved api_type
